an7.54:1.1: athakho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.54:1.2: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena sutavato ariyasāvakassa vicikicchā nuppajjati abyākatavatthūsūti.
an7.54:2.1: diṭṭhinirodhā kho bhikkhu sutavato ariyasāvakassa vicikicchā nuppajjati abyākatavatthūsu.
an7.54:2.2: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho bhikkhu diṭṭhigatametaṃ
an7.54:2.3: na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho bhikkhu diṭṭhigatametaṃ
an7.54:2.4: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho bhikkhu diṭṭhigatametaṃ
an7.54:2.5: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho bhikkhu diṭṭhigatametaṃ.
an7.54:2.6: assutavā bhikkhu puthujjano diṭṭhiṃ nappajānāti diṭṭhisamudayaṃ nappajānāti diṭṭhinirodhaṃ nappajānāti diṭṭhinirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānāti
an7.54:2.7: tassa sā diṭṭhi pavaḍḍhati so na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.54:3.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhu ariyasāvako diṭṭhiṃ pajānāti diṭṭhisamudayaṃ pajānāti diṭṭhinirodhaṃ pajānāti diṭṭhinirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti
an7.54:3.2: tassa sā diṭṭhi nirujjhati so parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.54:3.3: evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi na byākaroti
an7.54:3.4: na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi na byākaroti
an7.54:3.5: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi na byākaroti
an7.54:3.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti na byākaroti
an7.54:3.7: evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ evaṃ abyākaraṇadhammo hoti abyākatavatthūsu
an7.54:3.8: evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ nacchambhati na kampati na vedhati na santāsaṃ āpajjati abyākatavatthūsu.
an7.54:4.1: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho bhikkhu taṇhāgatametaṃ
an7.54:4.7: na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho bhikkhu vippaṭisāro eso
an7.54:4.8: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho bhikkhu vippaṭisāro eso
an7.54:4.9: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho bhikkhu vippaṭisāro eso.
an7.54:4.10: assutavā bhikkhu puthujjano vippaṭisāraṃ nappajānāti vippaṭisārasamudayaṃ nappajānāti vippaṭisāranirodhaṃ nappajānāti vippaṭisāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānāti
an7.54:4.11: tassa so vippaṭisāro pavaḍḍhati so na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.54:5.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhu ariyasāvako vippaṭisāraṃ pajānāti vippaṭisārasamudayaṃ pajānāti vippaṭisāranirodhaṃ pajānāti vippaṭisāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti
an7.54:5.3: evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ nacchambhati
an7.54:5.6: na kampati na vedhati na santāsaṃ āpajjati abyākatavatthūsu.
an7.54:5.7: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena sutavato ariyasāvakassa vicikicchā nuppajjati abyākatavatthūsūti.
